scope: Marches, protests and gatherings about the safety of women and violence against women in India, each backed by a published report that we have read. We list an event only after reading a report of it, and we leave out anything that could identify a survivor. Entries are added by hand, so the list is a sample of what was reported and leaves out events that no report covered or that we have not read.

events.title: NSUI candle march over a reported rape on a bus
events.affiliation: Student wing of the Congress party
events.place: Delhi. The report does not say where the march was held.
events.date_note: The report was published on 2 September 2026 and says the march was held on Tuesday, which was 1 September.
events.what: NSUI students held a candle march over a reported gang rape on a moving bus. NSUI said the government's claims about women's safety were hollow.
events.quote: The National Students' Union of India (NSUI), the student wing of the Congress party, on Tuesday held a candle march

events.title: Reclaim the Night midnight march
events.place: Delhi University. The report names no site on campus.
events.date_note: The report was published on 2 September 2026 and says the march was held late on Tuesday night, which was 1 September.
events.what: Women students of Delhi University marched at midnight against a reported gang rape on a bus and for safer public spaces. SFI also released a Women Students' Manifesto ahead of the DUSU elections.
events.quote: The late Tuesday night march, organised by the Students' Federation of India (SFI) under its 'Reclaim the Night' campaign

events.title: Students protest in Delhi for better safety for women
events.place: Delhi, on streets near where the reported assault took place.
events.what: Hundreds of students, most of them women, marched on Wednesday evening, shouting slogans and holding placards. Reuters reported that some placards demanded freedom to go out at night without fear.
events.quote: NEW DELHI, Sept 23 (Reuters) - Hundreds of students protested in Delhi on Wednesday, demanding better safety for women

events.title: Lady Shri Ram College students' gathering on a charter of demands
events.organiser: Students of Lady Shri Ram College
events.place: Siri Fort Road, near Gargi College and Kamala Nehru College, Delhi.
events.date_note: The report was published at 9.45 pm on 24 September 2026 and announces the gathering for 4 pm tomorrow, which was 25 September. The Indian Express, cited on this page, reported that the students met on Siri Fort Road.
events.what: After marching over a reported rape in Kalkaji, the students announced a gathering to consult on a proposed Charter of Demands for Delhi Citizens and to release a Declaration of Demands for Delhi.
events.quote: LSR students have also announced consultations for a proposed “Charter of Demands for Delhi Citizens” at Siri Fort Road near Gargi College and Kamala Nehru College at 4 pm tomorrow.

events.title: Campus Justice March
events.date_note: The report was published on 27 September 2026 and says the march was held on Saturday, which was 26 September.
events.what: SFI students marched on women's safety and asked for a secure environment, accountability from the authorities and stronger steps to prevent violence against women.
events.quote: Students affiliated with the Students' Federation of India (SFI) held a "Campus Justice March" at Delhi University's North Campus on Saturday

events.title: Freedom March
events.place: Prayagraj, from the women's hostel of Allahabad University to Azad Park.
events.date_note: The report was published on 7 October 2026 and says the march was held on Tuesday evening, which was 6 October.
events.what: Students of Allahabad University marched against an alleged harassment case and rising violence against women. The report lists their concerns as safe public spaces with working CCTV, investigation and accountability, gender education, and no restriction on women's movement as a form of safety. Civil society members joined.
events.quote: Students of Allahabad University in Prayagraj Uttar Pradesh took to the streets on Tuesday evening, marching from the women’s hostel to Azad Park
